summary: Usage Insights page times out when querying 30-day range (route/model breakdown)
description:
Customer report (via CSM): Usage Insights page intermittently times out when selecting a 30-day time range. Reported during beta usage review; customer is using the route/model breakdown table for internal chargeback and prefers monthly (30d) views.

Issue summary
- When selecting Time range = Last 30 days on Console -> Usage -> Cost Insights -> Route/Model Breakdown, the page shows a spinner for ~20–30s then errors.
- Error shown in UI: "Something went wrong" / "Request timed out".
- Browser console shows 504 from insights query endpoint.

Impact
- Customer cannot use Insights for monthly reporting; they fall back to ad-hoc invoice exports, which do not provide route-level attribution.
- This blocks planned weekly/monthly reporting workflows and created concern about whether beta is production-ready for finance usage.

Environment
- Workspace: heliochat-prod
- Deployment mode: Hosted API
- Region: us-east
- Time range: Last 30 days
- Filters: Project = "production"; Route filter empty (All); Model filter empty (All)

Steps to reproduce (internal)
1) Enable Usage Insights beta for any medium/high-volume workspace.
2) Console -> Usage -> Cost Insights.
3) Select Last 30 days.
4) Leave Route/Model filters as All.
5) Observe request timing out (commonly at gateway timeout).

Expected
- Page loads within SLO (interactive query) or degrades gracefully (partial results banner / prompt to narrow range / offer export).

Actual
- Console query request returns 504; user must retry or narrow to 7d/14d.

Notes / artifacts
- Example request id (from customer HAR): req_01JMX8Z7K6QY8P2G9T1V
- Insights endpoint: GET /console/api/usage-insights/v1/breakdown?group_by=route,model&range=30d
- Gateway error: 504 upstream timeout at ~20s
- Support asked customer for an approximate volume band; Heliochat reports "~40–60M tokens/day" across multiple routes, frequent streaming.

Requested outcome
- Make 30d queries reliable (no timeouts) or provide a productized fallback: guidance/guardrails + export path for long ranges.

Owner / routing
- Initial triage by Support; routed to Console Backend + Telemetry Analytics for query optimization and/or server-side limits.
comments: 2026-02-06 09:22 PT — Dev Patel (Support): Opened ticket after Heliochat CSM escalation. Customer sees consistent timeouts for 30d range; 7d works. Asking Console Backend to confirm whether 30d is supported in beta and if we have a known limit.

2026-02-06 10:01 PT — Markus Klein (Solutions Eng): Confirmed on our side with heliochat-prod impersonation: 30d -> 504; 14d loads in ~6–9s; 7d loads in ~2–3s. Customer strongly prefers 30d for finance. Provided immediate workaround: export invoice CSV doesn’t have route/model; so not sufficient.

2026-02-06 10:34 PT — Felix Schneider (Console Backend): Acknowledged. Pulling traces for req_01JMX8Z7K6QY8P2G9T1V. Looks like query service is hitting warehouse with a non-partition-pruned scan and a heavy GROUP BY route+model+day. Will loop in Mei/Thomas for warehouse tuning.

2026-02-06 11:18 PT — Mei Lin (Data Eng): Found that for 30d we fall back to a raw events aggregation path when the pre-aggregated dataset is missing a partition for one dimension combo (streaming + retries join). That path is scanning significantly more data and building a hash aggregate that exceeds our configured 15s warehouse statement timeout. Proposed: ensure pre-agg coverage; add materialized view/index for common 30d query shape; and reduce join cost on route normalization mapping.

2026-02-07 08:47 PT — Thomas Baird (Telemetry): Confirmed cardinality explosion when route normalization fails for a subset of OpenAI-compat paths; untemplated routes create many distinct keys and make 30d GROUP BY expensive. This is more likely for high-volume tenants. Suggest short-term: cap query to top N routes/models for interactive views; long-term: ensure normalization at ingestion and enforce guardrails.

2026-02-10 14:26 PT — Felix Schneider (Console Backend): Deployed optimization behind beta flag in staging. 30d on staging data now returns in p95 ~6.8s for a Heliochat-like dataset. Still too slow in worst case; adding caching headers + query result cache key on (workspace, filters, time_bucket, group_by).

2026-02-12 16:40 PT — Felix Schneider (Console Backend): Shipped to prod us-east under feature flag. Related PR: https://github.com/redwood/redwood/pull/23178. Added UI banner when selecting 30d: "Large ranges may load slower; use Export for full detail" and a recommendation to use 7d/14d for interactive exploration. (Banner copy aligned with DevEx feedback.)

2026-02-13 09:03 PT — Dev Patel (Support): Followed up with Heliochat. They can now load 30d successfully (first load ~10–12s; subsequent loads faster). No more hard timeouts observed. They requested clearer note that interactive tables show top groups and that export provides full detail.

2026-02-14 11:22 PT — Elliot Price (Docs): Will add troubleshooting note in Usage Insights help doc: if 30d is slow, narrow range or filter by route/model; use Export for full-fidelity rows. Also adding explanation of "Other" bucket and why it exists (cardinality/perf).

2026-02-17 15:10 PT — Felix Schneider (Console Backend): Verified via logs for heliochat workspace: no 504s on insights breakdown endpoint in last 72h; p95 30d query latency ~9.4s; cache hit rate ~62% for repeated views. Marking resolved. Follow-up item remains: fix route normalization gaps to reduce cardinality further.
resolution: Resolved by optimizing warehouse query path for 30d interactive breakdowns (avoid raw-event fallback; improve partition pruning; add caching; cap interactive result rows with "Other" bucket). Added guidance in console (30d performance note + suggestion to filter/narrow range and use Export for full detail). Deployed to prod under beta feature flag; customer confirmed no further timeouts.
next_steps:
1) Continue monitoring 30d query latency + 504 rate for high-volume workspaces; alert if p95 exceeds SLO.
2) Follow up on route normalization completeness to reduce group cardinality and improve monthly queries (esp. OpenAI-compat paths).
3) Ensure docs/tooltips clarify top-N + "Other" semantics vs exports for full fidelity.
4) Consider raising async export prominence for 30d+ workflows (finance use cases).
